name: Shinjuku (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shinjuku ward emblem in white: a stylised angular device of interlocking strokes with a triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Shinjuku, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 March 1967.

features.role: Shinjuku ward emblem — a stylised angular device of interlocking strokes with a triangle
